title: Variable
description: One Variable: its plain-language definition, units, NASA source and hand-written possible causes. Kept apart from the catalog so the definition can be reused wherever a Variable is described.

definition.description: Plain-language definition a high school student can read.

land_only.description: True when the Variable needs a land mask, which also brings the land-fraction gate into play (BS-003).

possible_causes.description: Hand-written causes the Reason step offers, each labeled as context from scientists rather than a result of the data.
